### Item 1 — what the user expresses and how the simulator behaves

- Target: close the Travel Rewards Visa Signature ending 6841, "today, on this call"; motivation: the $95 annual fee "that just showed up on your statement".
- Authorisation: "fine confirming or clicking through anything yourself if the agent sends it to you" — runs customer-side tools on hand-over.
- Identity: mobile 8045550171; on request DOB 1979-11-02 + SSN last4 7154 → `verify_customer_identity` "Identity verified … (3 detail(s) matched this attempt)".
- Does not know balance or points.
- Conditional responses only: if told points would be lost → cash into checking, "not travel or gift cards"; if told the remaining balance must be set to pay automatically before closure → fine, from Interest Checking ending 7730, "the only checking account you have"; prefers autopay over paying today; annual fee coming off → "good, that is fair"; keep-open / no-fee switch → "no, just close it". He never raises the fee refund, autopay or points himself.

### Item 2 — act now / wait / refuse

Act now, synchronously. Grounds: card `7181c181-…` status active, days_past_due 0; closing is the cardholder's own decision and "A balance does not prevent closure" (card_closure_basis clauses 1–2); annual fee posted 2026-09-05, today 2026-09-15 → 10 calendar days, inside the 30-day window (annual_fee_billing_and_closing_refund clause 6); redemption allowed while active (rewards_redemption_and_forfeiture clause 4). The runbook states "no step waits for a payment to clear, a statement to close, a review, or any passage of time".

### Item 3 — objects, keys, rows

- Customer `472526c7-e205-4cfa-b99a-96a982133bef`.
- Card `7181c181-aa5b-467a-ae8a-a05643fb530f`: Travel Rewards Visa Signature, last4 6841, opened 2025-09-02, statement_closing_day 5, current_balance 386.82, last_statement_date 2026-09-05, last_statement_balance 343.02, minimum_payment_due 98.43, due 2026-09-30, autopay_option none, autopay_amount 0.0, autopay_source_account_id "", rewards_balance 13271.
- Checking `74012327-cc8d-4b64-87e7-1478f81caac1`: Interest Checking, last4 7730, active, ledger 4218.66 — the only checking; no savings; no disputes; no card requests.

The refund ground is the closing window, not a waiver error; both lead to bank_error.

### Item 4 — scored parameters in words

(a) Annual fee refund: closure within 30 calendar days after posting → "reversed in full on the bank error ground" (annual_fee_billing_and_closing_refund clause 6; card_closure_basis clause 4). Amount 95.00, source_item_id 954cba48, adjustment_reason `bank_error` (tool doc: "Only bank_error").

(b) Closing autopay (set_closing_card_autopay_dbe1c3a9):
- Option: fixed_amount (closing_card_autopay_instruction: "the closing autopay instruction recorded before the closure is a fixed-amount instruction").
- Amount: balance owed from the ledger at handling time with the refund already posted (closing_balance_owed_from_ledger: "any fee already refunded as part of the closing is out of the balance owed") = 386.82 − 95.00 = 291.82; cap (closing_autopay_statement_balance_cap) min(291.82, 343.02) = 291.82 ledger figure stands; > 0 so needed (closing_autopay_amount_final_figure); single half-up rounding → 291.82.
- Source: active PCB checking of the cardholder (closing_autopay_active_checking_requirement) → 74012327 (named by customer; only one).

(c) Points cash-out (cash_out_closing_card_points_6700a44f): all unredeemed points 13271 (unredeemed_points_at_closing ledger count); ≥ smallest redemption 5000 (rewards_redemption_values_and_forfeiture_terms) → 13271 in one deposit; value 13271 × 0.01 cash value = 132.71 (never travel value 0.0125); receiving account active checking named by cardholder → 74012327.

(d) Closure confirmation (confirm_card_closure_806ea607): amount owed at handling time 291.82 > 0 (balance_remaining_at_closure) → source 74012327 is active → keep the card's option at that moment (closed_card_autopay_option_precedence) = `fixed_amount`.

### Item 6 — problem tree from the visible documents alone

Root: "close the card" → confirm_card_closure_806ea607.
- Hop A (root ← points cash-out). confirming_card_closure, Entry condition: "All of the card's unredeemed points have been cashed out before the closure is confirmed. … Where the condition is unmet, the closure is not confirmed." Query: rewards_balance / ledger 13271 > 0 → unmet. Action: closing_card_points_cash_out (customer tool). Its own docs: active checking receiver, all points, ≥ smallest redemption — all satisfied; no further entry condition. Leaf.
- Hop B (root ← closing autopay). autopay_source_kept_on_closed_card, "Entry condition for closing a card that still owes": "A closing autopay instruction sits on an active checking account before a card that still owes a balance is closed. … Where a balance will remain and that condition is unmet, the closure is not confirmed." Query: autopay_option none, source "" → unmet; balance will remain (291.82 after the refund) → action set_closing_card_autopay_dbe1c3a9.
  - Hop B1 (closing autopay ← annual fee refund). The visible sizing rule counts the balance owed at handling time from the ledger with "any fee already refunded as part of the closing … out of the balance owed" (closing_balance_owed_from_ledger), and the fee must be refunded because the closure falls within 30 days (annual_fee_billing_and_closing_refund clause 6, card_closure_basis clause 4). The explicit ordering sentence is in the runbook (rewards_card_closure_procedure "Step 1 before step 2 … Recording the autopay first would lock in a fixed amount that still contains the fee refunded moments later"). No document gives this hop an "Entry condition" section of its own; it is walkable from the runbook plus the ledger rule. Action refund_closing_annual_fee_cfb04f99 (agent). Leaf.
- Problem list: {P1 annual fee refund; P2 closing fixed-amount autopay; P3 points cash-out; P4 closure confirmation}. Edges: P1 → P2, P2 → P4, P3 → P4. Order: P1, P2, P3, P4 (runbook order; P3 could run any time before P4 on value grounds).
- Counter-proof against "just close it": the two Entry condition sentences (confirming_card_closure; autopay_source_kept_on_closed_card) and clause 6 of the annual fee rules are visible and forbid confirming while points remain / while no closing autopay sits on an active checking with a balance remaining, and require the fee refund.

### Two-way counter-proof — closest alternatives excluded

- Closing autopay sized on 386.82: excluded by closing_balance_owed_from_ledger + runbook Q&A ("Its fixed amount would still contain the fee that is refunded moments later").
- Capped figure 343.02: cap applies only when ledger > last statement balance (closing_autopay_statement_balance_cap rule 3).
- statement_balance / minimum_due closing instruction: excluded by "is a fixed-amount instruction" (closing_card_autopay_instruction).
- Cash-out at travel value (165.89) or partial: excluded by closing_cash_out_points_and_value rules 1 and 4; gift card/travel excluded by closing_cash_out_receiving_account.
- Closure option none: excluded by closed_card_autopay_option_precedence (balance > 0, active source → card's option).
- Registering a separate closure request: excluded by card_closure_basis "Retired clause" and confirming_card_closure "No separate request".
- courtesy_waiver on the annual fee: excluded by refund tool doc ("never valid for an annual fee"); prorating excluded as irrelevant (inside window → full).

If the structured source declares this as a workflow, it is a legitimate rendering; if not, it is an aggregated prerequisite chain. To be decided on reveal.
- O2 (prerequisite placement). The hop P1 → P2 (refund before closing autopay) has no "Entry condition" section in any closing-autopay document; it is carried by the runbook and by one sentence of closing_balance_owed_from_ledger. To be compared with the source's prerequisite declarations.
- O3 (possible second homes). Sentences in depended-on documents restate "before the closure is confirmed": closing_card_points_cash_out ("the points are cashed out before the closure is confirmed"), closing_cash_out_points_and_value rule 1, closing_card_autopay_instruction ("recorded before the closure"), rewards_redemption_and_forfeiture clause 5 ("must therefore redeem before the closure is confirmed"). To be compared with the source text.
- O4 (retired surface), same as task 0 O2: deposit ways listed in the tier table while the deposit clause is retired.

Blind verdict (pre-reveal): unique solution reachable — refund 95.00 bank_error on 954cba48; closing autopay fixed_amount 291.82 on 74012327; cash-out 13271 points / 132.71 to 74012327; confirm closure with fixed_amount.
